qin_field_command.rule: Qin field-command offers must match demonstrated command scale, not only abstract qualification. A qualified candidate without verified Qin field command receives at most the registered first-command ceiling. Oversized vacancies may produce a probationary detached command drawn conservatively from the exact parent formation. Larger commands require completed verified Qin field service or an explicit persisted command-scale exception. Age is a soft ceiling rather than an absolute bar; exceptional ability may accelerate progression without erasing field-service requirements.
